==Overview==
The '''AfreecaTV Starleague Season 4''' (아프리카TV 스타리그 시즌4) or '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 4''', was an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]].

The Starleague features 3 qualifiers scheduled for Seoul, Daegu and Busan on September 2, 3 and 4, 2017, respectively<ref>[https://tl.net/forum/brood-war/526000-asl-season-4-update ASL4 qualifiers]</ref>.

Round of 24 play will begin on Sunday September 10, 2017. Broadcasting times will be announced at a later date.<br>

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qSrNI3OiZq0</embedvideo>

===Format===
<!--
;Preliminary Qualifiers
*24 groups of 32-128 players each, eight groups in each of Seoul, Daegu and Busan
*Single-elimination bracket: best-of-three
*Winner of each group advances
-->
;Round of 24 group stage
*[[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
*Top two players in each group advance

;Round of 16 group stage
* 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[AfreecaTV Starleague Season 3]]
*[[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
*Top two players in each group advance

;Elimination Stage
*Eight player single-elimination bracket
*Quarterfinals through finals: best-of-five
